thesis.core: The market trend is not matched by current normalized earnings. 2026H1 revenue recovered but attributable and recurring profit still declined, while the fastest-growing new-energy structural component business carries much lower gross margin than the legacy optical and signal-transmission businesses.
thesis.variant_wedge: New-energy CCS/connectors create a credible second growth leg, but current price already capitalizes a large earnings step-up before margin and capacity utilization are proven. Large construction-in-progress and rising borrowing make execution and cash-return discipline central to the thesis.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use 2026E normalized EPS bear/base/bull RMB0.35/RMB0.55/RMB0.90. The base assumes a meaningful H2 recovery from H1 EPS RMB0.15 but does not assume low-margin new-energy revenue immediately earns premium margins.

operating_and_financial_quality.judgment: Revenue diversification is real, but profit conversion, mix economics and capital intensity do not support the equity rerating.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: H1 EPS is RMB0.15 after 2025 EPS RMB0.085; scenarios allow substantial recovery while requiring evidence that new-energy growth converts to earnings.

catalysts: CCS and new-energy connector orders translate into high utilization and materially better incremental margins.
Signal-transmission and optical component margins stabilize while new-energy mix scales.
Operating cash flow grows faster than earnings despite the current expansion program.
kill_thesis: New-energy revenue grows without acceptable gross margin or return on invested capital.
Construction-in-progress and debt continue to rise ahead of utilization and free cash flow.
Core component margins deteriorate or customer concentration creates pricing pressure.
Convertible-bond-funded expansion dilutes returns without a matching normalized EPS uplift.

sources.title: 汇创达可转换公司债券决议及授权延长有效期公告

source_quality_note: Operating facts are anchored to CNINFO filings discovered by the governed D2 mechanical consumer. The completed-session price is public market data. Scenario earnings and multiples are analytical assumptions.
